name: Ming
body: 1. Deposit release. The Deed of Rescission, clause 2(4), says the deposit is to be released and returned to the Purchaser. This seems to conflict with the Deed of Variation (clauses 43.3 and 43.4) and the Escrow Deed (clause 2(3)), which release the deposit to the owner. Can this be corrected?

name: Ming
body: 2. Release threshold. The letter says release is not contingent on other owners, but Jerry mentioned around 50% of owners need to sign. What exactly is the threshold, and by what date will the Deed of Variation be signed and the deposit released?

name: Ming
body: 3. Completion date. Clauses 47.1(3) and 47.1(4) allow the Date for Completion to be extended, including for delays in other owners' contracts, and clause 47.2 rescinds my contract if another owner's is rescinded. Can 18 December 2028 be made a firm outside date?

name: Ming
body: 4. Paragraph 7.3. Can this be amended so LFD cannot vary or withdraw the proposal once an owner has signed the documents?

name: Ming
body: 5. Protection before escrow release. What protects owners between signing the Deed of Variation and the Escrow Release Date, given the current contract's conditions remain unmet?

name: Ming
body: 6. Escrow and purchaser. Would LFD agree to an independent escrow agent, and will a parent company guarantee be provided for LFD Chatswood 3 Pty Ltd?

name: Ming
body: 7. Legal costs. What is the amount of the legal costs allowance in paragraph 3.1(6)?

name: Ming
body: 8. GST. Why is the $150,000 described as inclusive of GST?

name: Ming
body: 9. Strata voting. Can clause 55.4 be removed or narrowed?

name: Ming
body: 10. Caveat. Will LFD commit in writing to removing its caveat if the New Contract ends?
